# 1.0.0 — Fastidious Falcon Lower Envs

Self-contained image for managing this EKS cluster: eksctl, kubectl and the AWS CLI, with the cluster config baked in. Start a shell in it with either of the commands below.

```bash
podman run -it --rm ghcr.io/kaptain-test-repos/fastidious/fastidious-falcon-lower-envs:1.0.0 /bin/bash
```

```bash
docker run -it --rm ghcr.io/kaptain-test-repos/fastidious/fastidious-falcon-lower-envs:1.0.0 /bin/bash
```

Automatic release for version 1.0.0 of fastidious-falcon-lower-envs by Kaptain build script.
